So far in 2025, global insurance-related startups have pulled in about $3.9 billion in seed-through growth-stage financing, per Crunchbase data — almost less than one-fourth of the 2021 peak dollars raised — with deal counts also on the decline. The lower deal count signals both potentially decreased investor interest in the space, as well as larger round sizes.
